

{{infobox Chinese|l=Yang Water Horse|kanji=壬午|romaji=mizunoe uma|onyomi=jingo|p=rénwǔ|w=jen-wu|mi=ʐən³⁵ u²¹|y=jam4 ng5|j=jam4 ng5|ci=jɐm ŋo|mc=ɲiɪm ŋo|oc-bs=ɲɨm ŋaʔ}}
{{Sexagenary cycle}}
'''Yang Water Horse''' (壬午, ''mizunoe uma''; onyomi ''jingo'') is the 19th of the sixty combinations of the {{ill|Sexagenary cycle|en|Sexagenary cycle|qid=Q246658|lt=Sexagenary cycle}}.

It is the 19th of the sixty stem-branch combinations, preceded by {{ill|Yin Metal Snake|ja|辛巳}} and followed by {{ill|Yin Water Goat|ja|癸未}}. The {{ill|Heavenly Stems|en|Heavenly Stems|qid=Q1190985|lt=Heavenly Stem}} ''壬'' is Yang Water, and the {{ill|Earthly Branches|en|Earthly Branches|qid=Q1072961|lt=Earthly Branch}} ''午'' (Horse) is Yang Fire; together they form a Mutual Destruction relationship in {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|en|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|qid=Q218652|lt=Wuxing}}.

==Pronunciation==
* English: Yang Water Horse (壬午)
** Chinese (Mandarin Pinyin): rénwǔ
** Cantonese (Jyutping): jam4 ng5
** Japanese:
*** Kun'yomi: mizunoe-uma
*** On'yomi: jingo
** Korean (Revised Romanization, Hangul): imo (임오)
** Vietnamese (Hán-Việt): Nhâm Ngọ

=== Events ===
* In {{ill|Tenshō (Momoyama period)|en|Tenshō (Momoyama period)|qid=Q1145058|lt=Tenshō Era}} 10th Year (1582 AD) – the {{ill|Tenshō-Jingo war|ja|天正壬午の乱|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tenshō Ren-Go Rebellion|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q10939819}}.
* In {{ill|Meiji era|en|Meiji era|qid=Q3125096|lt=Meiji era}} 15th Year (1882 AD) – the {{ill|Imo Incident|ja|壬午事変|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ren-Go Incident|ja_comment=fixed jawiki redirect|3=壬午軍乱|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q709191}} (also known as the Ren-Go Military Rebellion).

==Months of Yang Water Horse==
In a {{ill|Common Era|en|Common Era|qid=Q208141|lt=Common Era}} year whose last digit is 0 or 5 (i.e. when the {{ill|Heavenly Stems|en|Heavenly Stems|qid=Q1190985|lt=Ten Heavenly Stems}} are {{ill|Kanoe (庚)|ja|庚|lt=Kanoe (庚)|2=ja|3=庚|4=zh|5=庚|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Geng}} or {{ill|Kinoto (乙)|ja|乙|lt=Kinoto (乙)|2=ja|3=乙|4=zh|5=乙|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yi}}), the month of {{ill|May|en|May|qid=Q119|lt=May}} becomes the {{ill|Month|en|Month|qid=Q5151|lt=Month (Calendar)}} of Ren-Go. However, here the term “month” may refer either to the month of the {{ill|Japanese Lunisolar Calendar|ja|旧暦|11=Japanese Lunisolar Calendar|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Japanese Lunisolar Calendar}} or to a seasonal month (from {{ill|Mangzhong|en|Mangzhong|qid=Q1147880|lt=Mangzhong}} until the day before {{ill|Xiaoshu|en|Xiaoshu|qid=Q1190976|lt=Xiaoshu}}) as applicable.

==Days of Yang Water Horse==
The {{ill|Senjitsu|ja|選日|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Day Selection}} for a Ren-Go day is as follows.
=== Day Selection ===
A Ren-Go day is the 5th day of {{ill|Tsuchi (Japanese term)|ja|犯土|lt=Shōdo|lt_ja=小土|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Small Earth|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11571306}}.
